notes: Config-driven theme → FMP company-screener industry mappings. One FMP call per industry during scheduled/admin rebuilds only. fmp_industries = union(core + adjacent + weak_adjacent). Quality filters (min_market_cap=$50M, min_volume=100k) enforced client-side since FMP ignores those params.

ai_networking.notes: AI networking: switches, optical interconnects, networking silicon. seed_tickers always included. FMP results require keyword match. lkg/options = discovery context only.

semiconductors.notes: Parent rollup — broad semiconductor coverage: designers, equipment, materials. No keyword gate (intentionally broad).

semicap_equipment.notes: Pure semiconductor equipment/process/test. FMP restricted to Semiconductor Equipment & Materials only. Chip designers excluded. Electrical Equipment & Parts removed (was pulling wrong companies).

memory_storage.notes: DRAM, NAND, storage controllers. seed_tickers always included. exclude_tickers blocks generic semis that bleed in from SMH/SOXX ETF holdings. require_name_keyword_match=true ensures FMP screener only admits companies with proven memory exposure in their name.

clean_energy.notes: Solar, wind, hydro, storage, grid infrastructure.

solar.notes: Pure solar play — panels, inverters, installers, project devs.

drones.notes: Drones and autonomous aerial vehicles: defense UAV, eVTOL, commercial drones. Already clean, seed-based.

defense.notes: Defense prime contractors + specialist defense tech. ETF-based (ITA/PPA/XAR) for broader coverage. seed_tickers anchor canonical primes.

uranium_nuclear.notes: Uranium miners, enrichers, nuclear utilities, SMR developers.

rare_earth.notes: REE miners, processors, magnet manufacturers, critical minerals.

regional_banks.notes: Community and regional banks, S&Ls, mortgage banks.

crypto_equities.notes: Bitcoin miners, crypto exchanges, blockchain infrastructure.

datacenter_infra.notes: Data center infrastructure: colocation REITs, servers, networking. Uranium/nuclear/unrelated tickers excluded. FMP restricted to REIT-Specialty and Computer Hardware.

cybersecurity.notes: Cybersecurity: endpoint, network security, identity. ETF-based (CIBR) with seed anchors. Canonical names always included.

robotics_automation.notes: Robotics and automation: industrial robots, surgical robots, AI automation. ETF-based (BOTZ/ROBO). seed_tickers anchor canonical names.

biotech.notes: Small/mid-cap biotech. Lower cap ceiling to surface clinical-stage names.

lithium_battery.notes: Lithium miners, battery materials, cell manufacturers.

fintech.notes: Payments, lending, insurtech, neobanks, wealth tech.

quantum.notes: Quantum computing pure-plays. seed_tickers = canonical companies (bypass keyword match). QTUM proxy changed to custom (too broad, held generic semis). FMP restricted to Scientific & Technical Instruments + keyword gate.

space.notes: Launch, satellite, ground systems, space services.

agribusiness.notes: Seeds, fertilizers, ag equipment, crop processing.

lng_gas.notes: LNG exporters, natural gas pipelines, storage.

cloud_software.notes: Cloud software: SaaS, PaaS, cloud platforms. ETF-based (SKYY/CLOU) for broader coverage. seed_tickers anchor canonical names.

software.notes: Broad enterprise and consumer software, smaller names.

energy.notes: Oil & gas E&P, midstream, and services. Excludes majors via cap ceiling.

healthcare.notes: Broad healthcare — biotech, pharma, medtech, diagnostics, health plans.

materials.notes: Broad materials sector — metals, mining, specialty chemicals.

banks.notes: Regional and community banks. Superset of regional_banks.

chemicals_materials.notes: Specialty and advanced chemicals, materials science.

consumer_retail.notes: Consumer retail — specialty, restaurants, grocery, apparel.

insurance.notes: P&C, specialty, and life insurance carriers and reinsurers.

silver.notes: Silver and precious metals miners, royalty companies.

travel_transportation.notes: Airlines, trucking, rail, maritime, freight and logistics.

communication_services.notes: Telecom carriers, internet content, entertainment, media.

utilities.notes: Regulated electric, gas, water utilities and independent power producers.

real_estate.notes: Residential, industrial, office, retail, and specialty REITs.

consumer_staples.notes: Packaged foods, beverages, household products, grocery.

consumer_discretionary.notes: Autos, specialty retail, restaurants, leisure, apparel.

speculative_tech.notes: High-growth disruptive tech, ARK-style names, AI/ML plays.

photonics_lasers.notes: Photonics and laser companies. FMP restricted to Scientific & Technical Instruments only. Semiconductors and Electrical Equipment removed (pulled wrong companies).

power_cooling.notes: Data center power/cooling: UPS, thermal management, critical power. FMP restricted to Specialty Industrial Machinery. Explicit exclude list for companies historically bleeding in from Electrical Equipment & Parts.

substrates_packaging.notes: OSAT / advanced packaging / substrate suppliers. FMP:Semiconductors removed (pulled generic chip designers). Keyword gate required for all FMP additions.

technology.notes: Broad technology sector — software, hardware, semis, networking.

financials.notes: Broad financials — banks, insurance, capital markets, lending.
